SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', started_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, 
       LAG(COUNT(*), 1) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', started_at)) AS prev_month_trip_count,
       (COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*), 1) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', started_at))) AS change_in_trip_count
FROM trip
WHERE strftime('%Y', started_at) = '2025'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', started_at)
ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', started_at);
